title.narrative: Expanded comprehensive response to HIV/AIDS in Timor-Leste - Timor-Leste (01-Apr-2016-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: According to the Ministry of Health, HIV prevalence in Timor-Leste is estimated at 0.3%-0.68% of the adult population, 2.76% of the female sex worker (FSW) population and 1.33% of the population of men who have sex with men (MSM). This Program will address critical gaps in supporting and scaling-up the national response to HIV and AIDS and sexually transmitted infections (STI) by primarily pursuing the following objectives: improving and increasing coverage of strategic HIV and STI prevention services; strengthening and expanding HIV and AIDS treatment and care; strengthening health systems relating to STIs and HIV; strengthening community systems relating to STIs and HIV; and building an enabling environment for implementation of STI and HIV programs. The goal of this Program is to reduce HIV and AIDS and STI mortality and morbidity in Timor-Leste by enhancing related prevention and treatment services. Some of the groups targeted by this Program are: persons most vulnerable to becoming infected with HIV and AIDS and STI including MSM and FSWs; HIV-infected pregnant women; and persons co-infected with HIV and TB. This is a stand-alone single stream of funding (SSF) Round 10 HIV grant.
